title: [dynamo] Fix BatchNorm momentum=None with fullgraph compilation
body:
Fixes #194504

### Summary

Fix an issue where `BatchNorm` with `momentum=None` fails under
`torch.compile(..., fullgraph=True)` because `num_batches_tracked` is
converted to a Python scalar during tracing.

This change keeps the cumulative moving average factor as a Tensor and
adds Tensor momentum support to `F.batch_norm`.

### Changes

- Avoid Python scalar extraction of `num_batches_tracked` in `BatchNorm`.
- Add Tensor momentum handling in `torch.nn.functional.batch_norm`.
- Preserve the existing float momentum execution path.
- Add a regression test covering `BatchNorm1d`, `BatchNorm2d`, and
  `BatchNorm3d` with `momentum=None` under `fullgraph=True`.
- Update `SyncBatchNorm` to avoid `.item()` scalar extraction.

### Testing

- `python3 test/dynamo/test_modules.py -k test_batchnorm_momentum_none_fullgraph`
- `git diff --check`

The regression test passes successfully.
